This is a Stage-0 knockout (kill/no-kill triage) batch of a single instructed mark, VENQORI (requester ref project-ven-01), for downloadable software for water-quality monitoring with online training services attached — a consumer mobile app for water-quality readings sold through app stores rather than through the trade. The instructed classes are 9 (downloadable water-quality monitoring software), 42 (SaaS and technical/scientific water-testing services) and 41 (online training), and Class 35 has been added as a belt-and-braces class because the product reaches its customers by app-store distribution, which is retail-adjacent. Flagged: VENQORI reads as a coined, dictionary-empty string, so the sweep should weight phonetic and near-miss neighbours (VENQOR-, VENCORI, VENQUORI and similar) rather than dictionary sense; no umbrella or parent brand is named or implied in the instructions, so nothing beyond the single instructed mark was added.
